subject: Horizon sync: renewal window & accelerated upsize
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon sync: renewal window & accelerated upsize

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Quick note from our side as we look at the H2 product launch: Nimbus Health is planning a phased national rollout in Q4, which means we need a capacity profile that starts modest but can spike ~3x during the first 90 days. Our renewal is due Oct 1 and we want to explore options to restructure the term so we can: 

- Anchor to a multi-year commitment for price predictability,
- Add a front-loaded burst bucket for launch months, and
- Keep an annual true-up (or an alternative) so we don’t overcommit early.

Can Redwood do an accelerated upsize plan that keeps our invoices predictable but gives breathing room for launch traffic? Also procurement will need SOC2 Evidence and a formal quote. Attaching our internal launch forecast (stub: Nimbus-launch-forecast.csv).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call next week.

— Asha
VP Product, Nimbus Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon sync: renewal window & accelerated upsize

Asha — really appreciate the context and congrats on the launch timeline. We can definitely design a renewal that matches those needs. High-level options we commonly use: 

1) 3-year anchored commit with a "burst reserve" pool (prepaid credits) that your team can draw during the 90-day launch window; annual true-ups to reconcile usage.
2) 24-month commit with a larger first-year allocation and an automatic rollover to a smaller baseline in year 2 unless you trigger an upsell (keeps cashflow lighter).
3) 12-month term with a short-term burst add-on + emergency surge lane (higher per-token rate for spikes) — lower commitment but higher marginal cost.

For Nimbus I think option 1 or 2 maps best if you want price predictability. I attached an initial pricing workbook (stub: initial-pricing-v2.xlsx) with sample token buckets and a modeled invoice for a 3x launch spike.

Next steps I propose:
- Camila, can you prepare two quote paths (3yr with burst reserve; 24mo front-loaded) and include an auto-renew/opt-out clause we can present to procurement?
- Asha, if procurement needs an SOC2 package, I’ll attach our SOC2 summary and point them to the evidence bundle.
- Schedule a 30-min sync early next week to finalize the MAP.

Available: Mon/Tues 10–2 PT.

Thanks — Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon sync: renewal window & accelerated upsize

Rishi — noted. Will draft two formal quote options and include the legal language around co-terming and auto-renew opt-outs. A couple quick internal notes as I build the quotes: 

- For multi-year: offer a 10% list discount on the committed units if Nimbus signs 36 months upfront (we can phase recognition across years).
- Burst reserve: recommend a dedicated burst bucket sized at 40% of projected first-90-days peak (gives headroom + avoids per-token spike pricing).
- True-up cadence: propose quarterly true-ups for year 1, annual thereafter.

I’ll circulate quote drafts (Quote A = 36m anchored; Quote B = 24m front-loaded) by EOD Monday.

— Camila

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon sync: renewal window & accelerated upsize

Thanks Rishi / Camila — that framing is helpful. Procurement is asking for: 

- Formal quote PDF with line items for committed units, burst reserve, and the proposed discount,
- SOC2 evidence summary + scope statement, and
- A short MAP (mutual action plan) showing milestones for PO, onboarding, and the launch spike window.

We prefer a single invoice cadence if possible (quarterly). Can you include that as an option? Also looping in our procurement lead (procurement@nimbushealth.com) to coordinate timelines.

Asha

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@nimbushealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon sync: renewal window & accelerated upsize

Great — we’ll get everything over. Summary / next steps: 

1) Camila to deliver Quote A (36m anchored w/ 40% burst reserve) and Quote B (24m front-loaded) — delivery by Mon EOD.
2) I’ll attach SOC2 summary and a one-pager MAP for PO/onboarding (shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink).
3) We’ll include both quarterly invoicing and single-invoice quarterly consolidation as line-item options in the quote.
4) Proposed sync: Tue 2027-06-15 10:00 PT for 30 min to walk through quotes and get verbal go/no-go for procurement timelines.

Attachments to follow: NIM-quote-v3.pdf, SOC2-summary-Redwood.pdf.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

— Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
